CREATE TABLE DimCustomer
(
	ID             INT,
	Title	       NVARCHAR(10),
	FirstName      NVARCHAR(100),
	MiddleName     NVARCHAR(100),
	LastName       NVARCHAR(100),
	Suffix	       NVARCHAR(100),
	CompanyName    NVARCHAR(200),
	SalesPerson    NVARCHAR(200),
	EmailAddress   NVARCHAR(100),
	Phone	       NVARCHAR(100)
)

select * from DimCustomer;
